  • ccusage (⭐2) - Displays real-time AI usage costs from the ccusage CLI tool directly in your terminal prompt.
  • cwebp (⭐0) - Converts common image formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF) to WebP format using Google's cwebp tool in batch mode.
  • fzf-git-worktree (⭐0) - Manage git worktrees with fzf (⭐73k) integration.
  • valet (A909M) (⭐4) - Works with both Laravel Valet and Valet Linux on Debian/Ubuntu. Provides intelligent autocompletion, helpful aliases, and utility functions to streamline your local development workflow.
  • valet (NasirNobin) (⭐9) - Reads .valetphprc from the project root and will switch to that PHP version automatically.
  • vscode-shell-integration (⭐0) - automatically activates VS Code shell integration when working in VS Code terminals.
  • zshclean (⭐0) - Helps you keep your $HOME directory tidy by removing temporary files and common system clutter. It supports both macOS and Linux, safely deleting common cache, history, swap, and log files with a single command.

Themes / superconsole - Windows-only

  • catppuccin-powerlevel10k-themes (⭐6) - Powerlevel10k (⭐50k) themes inspired by the Catppuccin color palettes. These themes are available in multiple styles and support all four Catppuccin palettes: 🌻 Latte, 🪴 Frappé, 🌺 Macchiato, and 🌿 Mocha.
  • pawsh (⭐0) - Pawsh is a super kawaii zsh theme for oh-my-zsh, inspired by Japanese neko culture. Your prompt becomes a cute cat face (ᓚᘏᗢ) that changes color depending on your command's mood. Includes decorators for root status, prompt color changes based on exit status of the last command run, current directory, Python virtualenv, vi-mode indicator, git status, and the current time.
